# Muazzez Aydın

> Muazzez Aydın is a React Native developer who builds production-ready mobile apps, native modules and CI/CD pipelines, and runs her own app studio, Innovelf.

Site: https://muazzeza.github.io/
Contact: innovelftech@gmail.com

## About

- Role: founder of Innovelf; previously Middle React Native Developer at Tribe (Sep 2023 – Nov 2026).
- Education: BS in Computer Engineering, Konya Technical University, 2019–2023.
- Skills: React Native, Expo prebuild, TypeScript, native modules (VPN, PDF, e-signature, image processing), Supabase, RevenueCat, Jenkins, Fastlane, Firebase, CI/CD.

## Experience

- Middle React Native Developer, Tribe, Sep 2023 – Nov 2026
- React Native Intern, Doser Logistics, Aug 2023
- Junior React Native Developer, City Technologies Center, Aug 2022 – Sep 2023
- Flutter Intern, City Technologies Center, Jul 2022

## Selected work

- [Innerlyo](https://innovelf.netlify.app/innerlyo/): AI mood journal. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/innerlyo-mood-ai-journal/id6756851264)
- [StickyNote](https://innovelf.netlify.app/stickynote/): note-taking app with widgets. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/sticky-note-widgets-lists/id6801887106)
- [CoupleCare](https://innovelf.netlify.app/couplecare/): AI relationship coach. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/couple-care-relationship-ai/id6746072410)
- [VocabHive](https://innovelf.netlify.app/vocabhive/): personal dictionary for language learners. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/vocabhive/id6745320238), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.innovelf.vocabhive)
- [Farketmez](https://innovelf.netlify.app/farketmez/): decision helper. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/farketmez/id6745528302), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.innovelf.farketmez)
